history.summary: A 27-year-old 99-year leasehold 2BR in Serangoon (D19) just 210m from CC14 Lorong Chuan MRT, priced at $1,567 psf — bang on the $1,560 URA median. Excellent MRT walkability and a deep 59-txn series, offset by aging leasehold (~72 years left) and a fair-not-cheap price.
history.rating_rationale: The standout is location: 210m to CC14 Lorong Chuan on the Circle Line, near Nex mall and good schools (St Gabriel's belt) — top-tier walkability that supports both rental and resale. The 59-txn URA series is the deepest in this thin-data batch, making the 6.6%/yr resale rate reliable. However PSF $1,567 is essentially at the $1,560 median (no margin of safety), and it is a 1999 leasehold (~72 years remaining) where lease decay is now a real forward drag. 893 sqft 2BR is efficient and the $1.4M quantum is liquid. Fair price + great location + lease decay = a balanced Neutral.
red_flags: 99-year leasehold from 1999 — ~72 years left, lease decay weighs on forward resale
Priced at the URA median — no value cushion
catalysts: CC14 Lorong Chuan MRT 210m away — excellent Circle Line walkability
Near Nex mall and reputable schools — strong tenant/family demand
